controller.mapping_summary: Saturn digital controller profiles map two pads or dual multitap topologies to YabaSanshiro.

firmware.notes: YabaSanshiro requires the Saturn BIOS listed by core-info and publishes its MD5 digest.

saves.naming: YabaSanshiro stores Saturn backup RAM in the fixed bkram.bin image.
saves.notes: Per-game backup entries live inside the backup-RAM image; this is not a per-game sidecar extension.
